answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 10501 Country: United Kingdom Title: What is the Family tree of Isa alayhissalam? 2- Is he from the Family of Dawud alayhissalam? 3-What does the arabic word Manhaj mean? Question: What is the Family tree of Isa alayhissalam? 2- Is he from the Family of Dawud alayhissalam? 3-What does the arabic word Manhaj mean? Answer ID: 10501 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 230/49=TL/1430) (1-2) The family tree of Hadhrat Eisa (peace be upon him) is available in Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah 2:56 and Qisasul Quran 4:15 and lineage reached to Hadhrat Dawood (peace be upon him) with a bit difference: وفیہ مخالفۃ کما ذکرہ محمد بن اسحاق و لا خلاف أنھا من سلالۃ داؤد علیہ السلام (البدایۃ والنھایۃ ۲:56 ) (3) Manhaj means: path, methodology etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
